browser_login.title: 小米运动健康 — Browser Login
browser_login.description:
Open the link below, sign in to your Xiaomi account in the browser and confirm (any verification happens inside that page):

[Sign in to Xiaomi account]({login_url})

After confirming, come back here and press Submit — the integration finishes automatically.

You can also scan this QR code with your phone (optional):

![QR](data:image/png;base64,{qr_image})

The link is valid for about {timeout} seconds and refreshes automatically when expired.{status}

wait_login.title: Waiting for login
wait_login.description:
Waiting for you to finish the login in the browser…

This page continues automatically once confirmed. Haven't opened it yet? Click: [Sign in to Xiaomi account]({login_url})

error.link_start_failed: Could not obtain a login link. Press Submit to retry.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Mi Fitness API. Check region and internet.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Xiaomi account is already configured.
